newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline trims losses as crude recovers.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline trims losses as crude recovers.

text.p: NWE gasoline trimmed some losses as crude prices bounced off their session lows, but the market was still down sharply from Wednesday.
Unleaded regular traded this morning at $220 fob ARA and then dipped to a low of $216 before trading again at $218, down $8-9 from Wednesday, traders said.
Eurograde barges traded twice at $228 fob ARA, down $7 from Wednesday.
Traders said tight supply of high octane gasoline was balanced against weaker crude and distillate prices.
